tests.description: Electrostatic charges prevention on CATEGORY AP and APG ME EQUIPMENT

Provision of electrically conductive paths to conductive floor, protective earth, potential equalization system, or via wheels to antistatic floor

tests.description: Corona cannot be produced by components operating at more than 2000 V a.c. or 2400 V d.c. not included in ENCLOSURES complying with G.5.4 or G.5.5
Requirements and tests for CATEGORY AP ME EQUIPMENT, parts and components
ME EQUIPMENT, its parts or components do not ignite FLAMMABLE AESTHETIC MIXTURES WITH AIR under NORMAL USE and CONDITIONS per G.5.2 to G.5.5

tests.description: Short circuiting conductor(s) to conductive part without explosive gasses where insulation contacts part with FLAMMABLE AESTHETIC MIXTURE WITH OXYGEN or NITROUS OXIDE, ignitable gases, or oxygen did not result in loss of integrity, unacceptable temperature, or HAZARDOUS SITUATION

semantic_fragments.content: For CATEGORY AP ME EQUIPMENT: electrostatic charges shall be prevented by a combination of appropriate measures including use of antistatic materials with limited electrical resistance, and provision of electrically conductive paths from ME EQUIPMENT or its parts to a conductive floor, protective earth or potential equalization system, or via wheels to an antistatic floor of medical room. Electrical resistance limits of aesthetic tubing, mattresses and pads, castor tires, and other antistatic material shall comply with ISO 2882 based on measurements according to ISO 1853, ISO 2878 and ISO 23529.
Corona cannot be produced by components or parts of ME EQUIPMENT operating at more than 2000 V a.c. or 2400 V d.c. and not included in ENCLOSURES complying with G.5.4 or G.5.5.

For CATEGORY AP ME EQUIPMENT: parts in contact with gas mixtures in NORMAL USE and CONDITIONS shall not produce sparks and shall not result in surface temperatures above 150°C in case of restricted or 200°C in case of unrestricted vertical air circulation, measured at 25°C ambient temperature, to comply with G.5.1.

For circuits producing sparks under G.5.3, energy limitations apply: combinations of currents and voltages within IzR·UzR ≤ 50W (no extrapolation above 42V); combinations of capacitances and voltages within C/2·U² ≤ 1.2mJ (no extrapolation above 242V); combinations of currents and inductances within L/2·I² ≤ 0.3mJ (no extrapolation for inductances > 900mH). When equivalent resistance R < 8000Ω, Umax shall be determined using actual resistance. For a.c. supply, peak values shall be considered. For complicated circuits, an equivalent circuit shall be calculated to determine equivalent Cmax, Lmax, Umax, Imax.
